# GO XPERT SOLUTION (GoXpert)

> Registered Building Surveyors in Malaysia. We inspect buildings and produce
> evidence-grade condition reports — for homeowners claiming defects within their
> Defect Liability Period, for corporations and JMB/MC managing building assets,
> and for owners who need documentation that holds up at the Tribunal for
> Homebuyer Claims.

## Facts

- Legal name: GO XPERT SOLUTION
- Company registration number: 202503234804 (003768196-A)
- Website: https://goxpert.my/
- WhatsApp / phone: +6011-3144 6591
- Email: official@goxpert.my
- States served: Johor, Melaka, Negeri Sembilan, Selangor (other locations on request)
- Inspectors are registered with the Royal Institution of Surveyors Malaysia (RISM)
- Measuring instruments are calibrated by SIRIM Malaysia
- Languages: English and Bahasa Malaysia

## What we are good at

- Finding defects that are invisible to an untrained eye: hollow tiles by tap-test,
  moisture inside walls by thermal imaging and moisture meters, missing earthing by
  instrument testing rather than guesswork.
- Writing findings so they can be acted on: exact location, defect category, photo,
  measured reading and date — not a vague complaint a developer can dismiss.
- Re-inspection: verifying that rectification work was genuinely done, with a
  before-and-after record for every item.
- Independence: we do not sell repair works, so our findings are not a sales list.

## Services

- [Home Defect Inspection (DLP)](https://goxpert.my/services/home-defect/): Catch every defect before your Defect Liability Period expires.
- [Pre-Purchase Inspection](https://goxpert.my/services/pre-purchase/): Buying a sub-sale home? Know the true condition — before you sign.
- [Sub-Sale Inspection](https://goxpert.my/services/sub-sale/): Bought an older home? Know its true condition and plan repairs right.
- [Re-Inspection](https://goxpert.my/services/re-inspection/): Verify the developer actually fixed what they promised.
- [After-Renovation Inspection](https://goxpert.my/services/after-renovation/): Make sure your contractor delivered what you paid for.
- [Joint Inspection with Developer](https://goxpert.my/services/joint-inspection/): When the developer disputes your defects or comes to close them — we stand on your side.
- [Building Condition Assessment (BCA)](https://goxpert.my/services/bca/): A systematic health check for your entire building.
- [Dilapidation Survey](https://goxpert.my/services/dilapidation/): Protect yourself before construction starts next door.
- [Building Monitoring](https://goxpert.my/services/monitoring/): Track movement and cracks before they become failures.
- [Commercial Building Inspection](https://goxpert.my/services/commercial-inspection/): Offices, shoplots and factories — inspected to scope.
- [Maintenance Report / Condition Audit](https://goxpert.my/services/maintenance-audit/): Know what needs fixing first — and what it will cost.
- [Electrical Inspection](https://goxpert.my/services/electrical/): Calibrated testing for a system you cannot see.
- [Leak Detection & Moisture Survey](https://goxpert.my/services/leak-detection/): Find the source — not just the stain.
- [Thermal Imaging](https://goxpert.my/services/thermal-imaging/): See what the naked eye cannot.
- [Rectification Defect](https://goxpert.my/services/rectification/): The right repair method, verified after the work.
- [Tribunal Consultation & Documentation](https://goxpert.my/services/tribunal/): Evidence strong enough for your claim.

## Who should contact us

- New homeowners inside their Defect Liability Period (DLP)
- Buyers of sub-sale or pre-owned homes, before signing
- Owners who have just completed a renovation and want it verified before final payment
- JMB / MC / property managers planning a sinking fund from actual building condition
- Owners in dispute with a developer who need documented, instrument-backed evidence
